title: Newhalo statement
description: A full-bleed black band with a huge amber-to-red gradient heading that fills in from the left as it scrolls into view, a small rounded square photo beside a short paragraph and orange button, and a tall art slot on the right. On phones it stacks: heading, centred photo, text, button, art.
notes: always dark (wraps itself in .dark); the gradient runs from the theme's highlight to its glow
the art slot was a 3D dot field in the original: put a canvas, video or image there
